audience: marketers and developers who send email with SendGrid

useCases.title: Check delivery, bounce and spam numbers for a period
useCases.text: Gets global email statistics for a date range, such as delivered, opens, clicks, bounces and spam reports, and summarizes the trend.

useCases.title: List bounced and unsubscribed addresses
useCases.text: Lists the bounce suppression list with the reason for each bounce, and the global unsubscribe list.

useCases.title: Check our marketing contacts and lists
useCases.text: Reads the total number of marketing contacts, lists the contact lists with their sizes, and looks up contacts by exact email address.

useCases.title: Review our email templates
useCases.text: Lists transactional email templates and opens one to read its versions with subject and content.

useCases.title: Send an email or a template email
useCases.text: Sends a real email to the recipients you give, with a subject and content or with a template id and its values.

useCases.title: Add or update marketing contacts
useCases.text: Creates new marketing contacts or updates existing ones by email, and can add them to lists. It runs as a job with an id.
